name: Backward-facing step · Re 36000 · SST
description: Driver–Seegmiller backward-facing step with graded quadrilateral blocks and experimental Cp, Cf and velocity profiles.

expectations.notes: The default example loads a shared structured reference mesh; choose a mesh preset or generate a new mesh to study refinement. Velocity-blended wall viscosity, bounded convection and conservative non-orthogonal correction are enabled. Results require numerical validation.

sources.title: Features of Reattaching Turbulent Shear Layer in Divergent Channel Flow

comparisons.procedure: Find the downstream negative-to-positive zero crossing of signed lower-wall Cf after the main recirculation region; x_r/H=(x_r-0)/H. Experimental reported uncertainty is +/-0.10 H; this is not a numerical convergence criterion.
Cf=2*tau_x/(rho*Uref^2); retain sign and source error bars, use lower wall only.
Cp=2*(p/rho-p_ref/rho)/Uref^2; align constant offset to zero near x/H=40. The file also retains original Cp.
Use the same pressure offset as bottom-wall Cp, not an independent fit.
Sample at x/H=-4; normalize U by measured upstream Uref and y by H. Reference includes V and turbulent moments, with factors recorded in column names.
Sample at x/H=1; normalize U by measured upstream Uref and y by H. Reference includes V and turbulent moments, with factors recorded in column names.
Sample at x/H=4; normalize U by measured upstream Uref and y by H. Reference includes V and turbulent moments, with factors recorded in column names.
Sample at x/H=6; normalize U by measured upstream Uref and y by H. Reference includes V and turbulent moments, with factors recorded in column names.
Sample at x/H=10; normalize U by measured upstream Uref and y by H. Reference includes V and turbulent moments, with factors recorded in column names.

verification.notes: Use the measured centre-channel Uref near x/H=-4, not automatically the inlet velocity. H=0.0127 m; coordinates match the experiment: downstream floor y/H=0, upstream floor y/H=1. Check upstream Re_theta~5000, delta/H~1.5 and Cf~0.0029. Adjust inlet speed or development length if necessary. Resolve and inspect y+; compare three meshes and time steps; average after startup and report averaging interval. Native SST is not asserted equivalent to NASA SSTm. The 2D incompressible model omits sidewalls and small Mach=0.128 effects. The mapped quadrilateral mesh grades toward the walls and step. Check wall y+ independently. The run stops at the configured step budget or end time; continue as needed.
